title: Inaugural API Quick Tiles — Compact model select + Request Composer screenshots
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Goal: Produce a compact, mobile-friendly set of onboarding screenshots for the Hosted API quickstart that emphasize: 1) model selection in a condensed picker, 2) in-context request composer (model + temperature + system prompt snippets), and 3) 3-language code snippets (curl, Python, JS) with copy-to-clipboard affordances. Scope: deliver 6 final PNGs (3 desktop, 3 mobile) and a Figma component kit with tokenized colors and spacing. Visual constraints: fit within existing Console header and use existing iconography; avoid reusing the 'launchpad' or 'quickstart' copy verbatim across screens. Acceptance criteria: images exported at 1440x900 and 375x812, annotated handoff sheet in Figma, accessibility checks for contrast >= 4.5:1 for interactive labels, and a short README describing how screenshots map to docs pages. Deliverables must include links to the example request used for each screenshot and the snippet text so docs can copy-paste directly.
tasks: Draft compact model picker layout (desktop + mobile)
Design request composer with 3-size token variants for prompt area
Write code snippet examples for curl, Python, and JS (fetch) using redwood-hosted endpoint
Export annotated PNGs and prepare Figma handoff file
Upload assets to Drive and link into docs PR
